observations: Photo 0 shows a black PlayStation 4 console with a camouflage-patterned controller in front of it.
Photo 1 shows the same console with a standard black controller in front.
The console has visible scratches and scuffs on the top surface in both photos.
The controller in photo 0 has a green camouflage pattern; the controller in photo 1 is standard black.
The console appears to be a PS4 Slim model based on the slim profile and design.
No games, cables, or accessories are visible in either photo.
The seller claims 10 pre-installed games including FIFA 27, PES 27, and GTA, but no games are shown.

claims.claim: Uk used ps4 with 1 pad and 10 pre-installed games which includes fifa 27, pes 27, gta...
claims.evidence: No games are visible in either photo. The controller in photo 0 is camouflage; the controller in photo 1 is standard. The claim of 10 pre-installed games cannot be verified from the photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not be functional or may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI, power).
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, loading a game, and connecting to a TV or monitor.

risks.risk: The controller may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axes.
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: The 10 pre-installed games may not be included or may be damaged or corrupted.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the games installed and accessible in the PS4 library.

risks.risk: The console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number on the back of the console and a verification check via PlayStation Network or a trusted source.

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number.
Video of the console powering on and playing a game.
Video of the controller connecting and working.
Photo or video of the 10 pre-installed games in the library.
Proof of origin (e.g., UK receipt or warranty card).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
